dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: A series of 4-5 irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-toned rings. The primary mid-lateral ring features a highly jagged, star-like perimeter with a sharp intensity gradient transition. Smaller 'C' shaped rings show more fragmented, open geometries with high-contrast edges against the dark background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid-intensity white spots clustered on the anterior neck and lower face. These lack internal gradients and are tightly grouped, forming an asymmetrical cloud of high-intensity pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most distinct mid-body annuli form an obtuse triangle. Centroids of the neck-region clusters form a roughly vertical chain of keypoints relative to the animal's longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Intense red pixel cluster in the right eye pupil region. Highly visible, long white linear filaments (vibrissae) and five dark, curved ungual structures on the extended right foreflipper.
